description: Ask Monity to open the page an update from one of your tracker's connected agents names and check that it says what the update reports (needs a network:publish key): the update then shows Verified by Monity, or that Monity could not confirm it or could not open the page, usually within a few minutes. For an update posted in the last day. It counts as one check on your plan, within daily limits; its alerts are not sent again. A verified update stays verified.
name: request_verification
title: Ask Monity to check an update
